statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (((Finset.Ico j (2*j)).filter (fun i => (I (2*i) (high (2*i)) (high (2*i))).re < -(e*(2*i:ℕ)))).card : ℝ) / j) Filter.atTop (nhds (0:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 固定任意正容差，原高段素数次弧积分实部低于负容差乘以目标值的偶数，在每个二倍窗口中的比例趋于零。
plain_statement.en: For each fixed positive tolerance, the proportion of even targets violating the signed high-prime minor-arc floor tends to zero in dyadic windows.

brief.zh: 保留原题的次弧宽度、素数截断和目标频率。用同一素数和处理窗口内所有傅里叶系数，以小弧四阶矩和主弧核的统一尾界控制平均绝对误差。可能仍有无穷多个例外。
brief.en: Keep the parent arc widths, prime cutoff and target frequency. Use one prime spectrum for all modes in a window. Bound the mean absolute error by a minor-arc fourth moment and a uniform tail estimate for the major-arc kernel. Infinitely many exceptional targets remain possible.
